title: ALIAS: Evaluating Performance and Memorization in LLM-Written TLA+ Specifications
title_zh: ALIAS：评估大语言模型编写的TLA+规格的性能与记忆化

paragraphs.en: Memorization inflates the benchmark scores of large language models, since a model can reproduce answers it saw in training. Researchers test for it with consistent identifier renaming (CIR), which gives every identifier in a task a new name, and treat a lower score on the renamed task as evidence of recall. We test this method on the Temporal Logic of Actions Plus (TLA + ) language, whose model checker acts as an oracle by confirming whether a renamed task keeps the exact behaviors of the original. Across 111 TLA + -Bench tasks, renaming lowers the correctness of Claude Opus 4.8 from 28% to 18% and of GPT-5 from 9% to 7%. Most of this decrease comes from how the test grades, which requires exact names that most descriptions never state. Grading by behavior shrinks the decrease to about 3 points for Opus 4.8 and to 0 for GPT-5. In two model families fine-tuned on disjoint halves of the tasks, renaming removes about half of the training gain in likelihood and costs 4.9 points (Qwen) and 1.3 points (Gemma) on unseen tasks. A lower score after renaming therefore mixes memorization, name-based grading and the cost of new names.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆化夸大了大语言模型的基准测试分数，因为模型可以复现它在训练中见过的答案。 研究者用一致性标识符重命名（CIR）来检测记忆化，即为任务中的每个标识符赋予一个新名称，并将重命名后任务上更低的分数视为记忆的迹象。 我们在动作时序逻辑加（TLA+）语言上检验这一方法，其模型检查器充当一个判定基准（oracle），通过确认重命名后的任务是否保持与原始任务完全相同的行为。 在 111 个 TLA+-Bench 任务上，重命名使 Claude Opus 4.8 的正确率从 28% 降至 18%，使 GPT-5 的正确率从 9% 降至 7%。 这一下降的大部分来自测试的评分方式，因为它要求精确的名称，而大多数描述从未给出这些名称。 按行为评分后，下降幅度缩小到 Opus 4.8 约 3 个百分点，GPT-5 则为 0。 在两个分别在与彼此不相交的任务子集上微调的模型家族中，重命名消除了约一半的对数似然训练增益，并在未见任务上损失 4.9 个百分点（Qwen）和 1.3 个百分点（Gemma）。 因此，重命名后的分数下降混合了记忆化、基于名称的评分以及新名称带来的代价。

paragraphs.en: TLA + is a formal specification language engineers use to find design errors in concurrent and distributed systems before they build them, and Amazon Web Services has reported subtle bugs found this way in DynamoDB and S3 Newcombe et al. (2015) . (1999) . Writing a correct specification takes time and expertise, so LLMs that write specifications from natural-language descriptions could help more engineers use the method. Benchmarks measure this by checking each generated specification with the TLA + parser SANY and the model checker TLC Cheng et al. (2026) ; Bisharat et al. (2026a) ; Bisharat et al. (2026b) .

paragraphs.en: We investigate memorization in LLM-written TLA + through three experiments on 111 TLA + -Bench tasks whose renamed copies pass SANY and TLC. Experiment 1 grades the outputs of Claude Opus 4.8 Anthropic (2026) and GPT-5 OpenAI (2025) the way TLA + -Bench grades them, with the configuration file of the reference specification, which often requires names that the description never states (illustrated in Figure 1 ). Experiment 2 fine-tunes two copies each of Qwen2.5-Coder-14B and Gemma 4 31B on disjoint halves of the tasks, so each task is seen by one copy and unseen by the other, and compares the renaming decrease on seen and unseen tasks. Experiment 3 grades the outputs of Experiment 1 again by behavior, which ignores names. Together, the experiments show that a lower score after renaming has three possible causes, memorization of the original task, a grading practice that requires names the model is never given and the extra difficulty of working with unfamiliar random names. This paper makes four contributions. We show that much of the decrease after CIR on TLA + -Bench comes from the grading procedure. We separate memorization from the cost of CIR with controlled fine-tuning on disjoint halves of the tasks, so the training exposure of every task is known. We measure the decrease after CIR with a grade that checks behavior and ignores names. We give recommendations for contamination tests and benchmark builders, and we release ALIAS, with the renamed tasks, the exposure split, all model outputs and the behavior-based grader. 1 1 1 https://github.com/LUC-AI4FM/ALIAS

paragraphs.en: TLA + is a language that describes how a system behaves over time Lamport (2002) . A specification lists the variables of the system, the starting states and the steps that may change the variables, together with the properties that the system must satisfy (see Figure D.1 for a small clock). SANY parses the module for TLA + syntax correctness and checks that every name in a specification is defined. TLC then explores every state that a finite instance can reach and checks invariants, which must hold in every state, and temporal properties, which must hold over whole behaviors Yu et al. (1999) (see Appendix B ). A configuration file gives TLC the constant values, the specification formula and the property names. A behavior is a sequence of states, and a specification G G refines a specification R R if every behavior of G G is also a behavior of R R . TLC checks this by running G G against the formula of R R after mapping the variables of R R to those of G G .
paragraphs.zh: TLA+ 是一种描述系统如何随时间演化的语言 Lamport (2002)。 规约列出系统的变量、初始状态以及可能改变这些变量的步骤，并给出系统必须满足的性质（参见 Figure D.1 中的一个小时钟示例）。 SANY 解析模块以检查 TLA+ 语法正确性，并验证规约中的每个名称都已有定义。 TLC 随后探索有限实例可到达的每个状态，检查必须在每个状态都成立的不变式，以及必须在整个行为上都成立的时序性质 Yu et al. (1999)（参见 Appendix B）。 配置文件向 TLC 提供常量值、规约公式以及性质名称。 行为是一个状态序列；如果 G G 的每个行为同时也是 R R 的行为，则称规约 G G 精化（refine）规约 R R。 TLC 的检查方式是：先把 R R 的变量映射到 G G 的变量，再用 R R 的公式去运行 G G。

sents.en: TLA + is a language that describes how a system behaves over time Lamport (2002) .
sents.zh: TLA+ 是一种描述系统如何随时间演化的语言 Lamport (2002)。

sents.en: A specification lists the variables of the system, the starting states and the steps that may change the variables, together with the properties that the system must satisfy (see Figure D.1 for a small clock).
sents.zh: 规约列出系统的变量、初始状态以及可能改变这些变量的步骤，并给出系统必须满足的性质（参见 Figure D.1 中的一个小时钟示例）。

sents.en: SANY parses the module for TLA + syntax correctness and checks that every name in a specification is defined.
sents.zh: SANY 解析模块以检查 TLA+ 语法正确性，并验证规约中的每个名称都已有定义。

sents.en: TLC then explores every state that a finite instance can reach and checks invariants, which must hold in every state, and temporal properties, which must hold over whole behaviors Yu et al.
sents.zh: TLC 随后探索有限实例可到达的每个状态，检查必须在每个状态都成立的不变式，以及必须在整个行为上都成立的时序性质 Yu et al.

sents.en: (1999) (see Appendix B ).
sents.zh: (1999)（参见 Appendix B）。

sents.en: A configuration file gives TLC the constant values, the specification formula and the property names.
sents.zh: 配置文件向 TLC 提供常量值、规约公式以及性质名称。

sents.en: A behavior is a sequence of states, and a specification G G refines a specification R R if every behavior of G G is also a behavior of R R .
sents.zh: 行为是一个状态序列；如果 G G 的每个行为同时也是 R R 的行为，则称规约 G G 精化（refine）规约 R R。

sents.en: TLC checks this by running G G against the formula of R R after mapping the variables of R R to those of G G .
sents.zh: TLC 的检查方式是：先把 R R 的变量映射到 G G 的变量，再用 R R 的公式去运行 G G。

paragraphs.en: TLC finds operators and constants by the names in the configuration file, so the line INVARIANT TypeOK asks TLC to check the operator called TypeOK . A TLA + -Bench task has a natural-language description, which the model receives, and a configuration file, which checks the model’s output. The human-written TLA + module behind each task is its reference specification , and the model never sees it Bisharat et al. (2026b) . An output passes only if it uses the exact name of every constant and property in the configuration file.
paragraphs.zh: TLC 通过配置文件中的名称查找运算符和常量，因此 INVARIANT TypeOK 这一行让 TLC 检查名为 TypeOK 的运算符。 一个 TLA + -Bench 任务包含一段自然语言描述（模型会收到这段描述）和一个配置文件（用于检查模型的输出）。 每个任务背后由人工编写的 TLA + 模块是其参考规范，模型永远看不到它 Bisharat et al. (2026b)。 只有当输出使用了配置文件中每个常量和属性的准确名称时，才能通过检查。

paragraphs.en: Renamed descriptions. Each specification in TLA + -Bench comes with a natural language description that mentions many of its operators and constants by name Bisharat et al. (2026b) . The original condition gives the LLM this description, and the renamed condition prompts the LLM with a copy of the original description in which those identifiers are replaced. Replacing every renamed identifier in the text would also change unrelated words, because authors use common words and algorithm names as identifiers (see Appendix G for the example and further details). We therefore rename each description with a fixed rule of three parts. A name that the configuration refers to is always renamed, because the model needs the new name for TLC to check its output. A lowercase word or a TLA + module name keeps its name. Every other identifier is renamed. This rule avoids damage to 45 descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 重命名后的描述。 TLA+ -Bench 中的每个规约都附带一段自然语言描述，其中按名称提及了该规约的许多运算符和常量 Bisharat et al. (2026b)。 原始条件将这段描述提供给大语言模型（LLM），而重命名条件则用原始描述的一个副本提示大语言模型，其中那些标识符已被替换。 替换文本中每一个被重命名的标识符也会改变无关的词语，因为作者常把常见单词和算法名称用作标识符（示例及更多细节见附录 G）。 因此，我们按照一个由三部分组成的固定规则对每段描述进行重命名。 配置所引用的名称总是会被重命名，因为模型需要新名称才能让 TLC 检查其输出。 小写单词或 TLA+ 模块名保留其名称。 其余所有标识符都会被重命名。 该规则避免了 45 段描述受到破坏。

paragraphs.en: Identifier kinds. We sort the identifiers of the reference specifications of the 111 tasks into three categories, domain words, TLA + conventions such as Init and TypeOK and abbreviations or single letter identifiers such as hr (see Appendix C ). Table C.1 shows that a third of the 1,788 identifiers that our CIR test modifies are domain words. The model never sees the reference specification and reads only its English description. Renaming changes the identifiers that this description mentions by name and leaves the rest of the text as it is, so ordinary words such as barrier or process remain (illustrated in Figure 1 ). Of the domain identifiers whose words the original description uses, 199/219 (91%) keep those words after CIR.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符种类。 我们将111个任务的参考规范中的标识符分为三类：领域词汇、TLA+惯例（如Init和TypeOK）以及缩写或单字母标识符（如hr）（见附录C）。 表C.1显示，我们的CIR测试所修改的1,788个标识符中有三分之一是领域词汇。 模型从未见过参考规范，只读取其英文描述。 重命名会改变该描述中按名称提到的标识符，而保留文本其余部分不变，因此barrier或process等普通词汇保持不变（如图1所示）。 在原始描述使用其词汇的领域标识符中，199/219（91%）在CIR之后保留了这些词汇。

paragraphs.en: Hidden required names. The configuration file of a task names the constants that TLC assigns values to, the invariants and properties that TLC checks and the constraints that limit the states TLC explores. An output is checked with this file, so it must define every identifier the file names. We call a listed identifier hidden if the description given to the model never mentions it by name. In the Barrier task, the configuration checks TypeOK and BarrierProperty , and the description mentions neither of these two names (illustrated in Figure 1 ). After renaming, the configuration asks for Octvcq and Bvwcdylhaazalut , so a correct output fails whether or not the model has seen the specification in training. We exclude Init , Next and Spec , because the prompt asks for them by name and the name-based grade accepts them under any name (see Appendix H ). In 78/111 tasks, the configuration file lists at least one hidden name, so a correct output must define that exact name to pass TLC, and 29 of these tasks list five or more. The 333 hidden names are 115 constants, 113 invariants, 87 properties and 18 constraints. With the original description, a model can still guess some hidden names without recall, because 77 follow TLA + conventions such as TypeOK . After renaming, every hidden name is a random string that no description, TLA + convention or published file contains. Renaming therefore changes two parts of a task, the description, which loses the author’s identifiers but keeps most of its domain words, and the configuration file, which requires exact names.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏的必需名称。 任务的配置文件指定了 TLC 为其赋值的常量、TLC 检查的不变式和性质，以及限制 TLC 探索的状态的约束。 输出会用该文件进行检查，因此输出必须定义该文件指定的每个标识符。 如果给模型的描述从未按名称提及某个被列出的标识符，我们就称其为隐藏的标识符。 在 Barrier 任务中，配置检查 TypeOK 和 BarrierProperty，而描述中未提及这两个名称（如图 1 所示）。 重命名后，配置要求 Octvcq 和 Bvwcdylhaazalut，因此无论模型是否在训练中见过该规约，正确的输出都会失败。 我们排除 Init、Next 和 Spec，因为提示按名称要求了它们，且基于名称的评分接受任何名称下的它们（见附录 H）。 在 78/111 个任务中，配置文件列出了至少一个隐藏名称，因此正确的输出必须定义该确切名称才能通过 TLC，其中 29 个任务列出了五个或更多。 这 333 个隐藏名称包括 115 个常量、113 个不变式、87 个性质和 18 个约束。 使用原始描述时，模型仍然可以无需回忆而猜出一些隐藏名称，因为其中 77 个遵循 TLA + 的惯例，例如 TypeOK。 重命名后，每个隐藏名称都是一个随机字符串，任何描述、TLA + 惯例或已发布的文件中都不包含它。 因此，重命名改变了任务的两个部分：描述部分失去了作者的标识符但保留了大部分领域词汇，而配置文件部分则要求确切的名称。

paragraphs.en: Behavior-based grade. This grade compares the behaviors of an output G G with those of the reference R R and does not require the names of the configuration file. It searches for a one-to-one mapping from the variables and constants of R R to those of G G , with identical names first and then up to 60 permutations. Under a mapping, the forward check runs G G and checks the specification formula of R R and the invariants and properties of its configuration, with the definitions of R R , so it passes when every behavior of G G is a behavior of R R and satisfies the properties of R R . The reverse check runs R R and checks the safety formula 𝐼𝑛𝑖𝑡 ∧ □ ​ [ 𝑁𝑒𝑥𝑡 ] v \mathit{Init}\land\Box[\mathit{Next}]_{v} of G G under the inverse mapping, so an output that allows too few behaviors, such as one that never moves, fails. G G is correct when both checks pass under one mapping (see Appendix H ). Variables whose string values act as control labels, such as the pc of a PlusCal translation, get extra handling (see Appendix I ). Each condition is graded against its own reference specification, so the renamed condition uses the renamed specification, its renamed imported modules and the renamed configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 基于行为的评分。 该评分将输出 G G 的行为与参考 R R 的行为进行比较，并且不需要配置文件的名称。 它会寻找一个从 R R 的变量和常量到 G G 的变量和常量的一一映射，优先使用相同名称，随后尝试最多 60 种排列。 在某个映射下，前向检查运行 G G，并使用 R R 的定义检查 R R 的规约公式以及其配置中的不变式和性质，因此当 G G 的每个行为都是 R R 的行为且满足 R R 的性质时，该检查通过。 反向检查运行 R R，并在逆映射下检查 G G 的安全公式 𝐼𝑛𝑖𝑡 ∧ □ ​ [ 𝑁𝑒𝑥𝑡 ] v \mathit{Init}\land\Box[\mathit{Next}]_{v}，因此允许过少行为的输出（例如从不移动的输出）将不通过。 当两项检查在同一映射下都通过时，G G 是正确的（见附录 H）。 对于其字符串值充当控制标签的变量，例如 PlusCal 翻译中的 pc，会进行额外处理（见附录 I）。 每个条件都对照其自身的参考规约进行评分，因此重命名后的条件使用重命名后的规约、其重命名后的导入模块以及重命名后的配置。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. We report three metrics for each sample. Parse , the output passes SANY with no syntax or semantic error. Correct, name-based , the output parses and passes TLC under the configuration of its condition. Correct, behavior-based , the output passes both refinement checks against the reference. We also report text similarity to the reference (see Appendix V ). The unit of analysis is the task. For each task and condition, the pass rate is the fraction of the five samples that pass, which estimates pass@1 Chen et al. (2021) . We report the mean difference between two conditions with a 95% confidence interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of tasks. We also report a two-sided sign test over the tasks whose pass rates differ. For the two renamings, we test equivalence with two one-sided tests at a margin of 5 points. Equivalence holds when the 90% bootstrap interval of the difference lies inside the margin.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 我们为每个样本报告三项指标。 解析成功：输出通过 SANY，无语法或语义错误。 正确（基于名称）：输出可解析，并在其条件对应的配置下通过 TLC。 正确（基于行为）：输出通过针对参考实现的两个精化检查。 我们还报告与参考实现的文本相似度（见附录 V）。 分析单位是任务。 对于每个任务和条件，通过率是五个样本中通过的比例，用以估计 pass@1 Chen et al. (2021)。 我们报告两个条件之间的均值差异，并给出由任务进行的 10,000 次 bootstrap 重抽样得到的 95% 置信区间。 我们还对通过率存在差异的任务报告双侧符号检验。 对于两次重命名，我们以 5 个百分点的边际进行两个单侧等价性检验。 当差异的 90% bootstrap 区间位于边际之内时，等价性成立。

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuned models. We split the 111 tasks at random with seed 20260926 into halves, A (55 tasks) and B (56 tasks). Both training sets contain the 292 model-checked TLA + -Bench tasks outside the test set. We fine-tune one copy of Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct on these 292 tasks and the 55 of half A, and a second copy on the 292 and the 56 of half B, and we shuffle each training set with a fixed seed. Each training pair consists of a declarative description and its reference specification. Every test task is thus seen by one model and unseen by the other. We call this task-pair exposure since the model sees each specification together with its test description. Both LLMs are fine-tuned with the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method Hu et al. (2022) and train for three epochs over their respective datasets, so each specification is seen three times in training (see Appendix E for the training settings). We test both models on the 110 tasks with a configuration in both conditions. We repeat the experiment with a second model family, Gemma 4 31B Gemma Team, Google DeepMind (2026) , fine-tuned on the same halves with the same training settings (see Appendix F ). Each model generates five samples per task and condition with temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.95 and at most 1,024 new tokens per sample.

sents.en: This experiment grades the same outputs of Opus 4.8 and GPT-5 again by behavior and compares the decrease under both grades on the same tasks.
sents.zh: 该实验对 Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5 的相同输出再次按行为进行评分，并比较同一任务在两种评分方式下的下降幅度。

paragraphs.en: Grader validation. As positive controls, the grade should accept each reference against itself, each renamed reference with its renamed imported modules and a copy of each reference with renamed operators that still passes SANY and TLC. As negative controls, it should reject mutants, which change one number, comparison, initial value, guard or disjunct of a reference, and we keep a mutant only if TLC reports a different number of reachable states (see Appendix J ). The grade covers the 90/111 tasks whose reference passes against itself, and both grades are compared on these tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 评分器验证。 作为阳性对照，评分应接受每个参考解与自身、每个重命名后的参考解连同其重命名的导入模块，以及每个参考解的副本（其中重命名的算子仍能通过 SANY 和 TLC）。 作为阴性对照，评分应拒绝变异体，即改变参考解中的某个数字、比较、初始值、守卫或析取项的变异体；只有当 TLC 报告的可达状态数量不同时，我们才保留该变异体（见附录 J）。 评分涵盖 90/111 个参考解能通过自身验证的任务，并且两个评分在这些任务上进行比较。

paragraphs.en: What Experiment 1 shows. Renaming lowers the correctness of Opus 4.8 by about a third, which a CIR test reads as memorization. The decrease sits on the 78 tasks with hidden names, where the renamed configuration asks for random names that no model can know, and the 33 tasks that state every name lose 7.3 points with an interval that includes 0. Meaningful names and file continuation do not explain the decrease. Under the grading of TLA + -Bench, a renaming decrease thus measures the grade as well as the model, and Experiment 3 tests how much.
paragraphs.zh: 实验 1 展示了什么。 重命名使 Opus 4.8 的正确率下降约三分之一，CIR 测试将其解读为记忆效应。 该下降集中在 78 个名称被隐藏的任务上，在这些任务中，重命名配置要求模型给出任何模型都不可能知道的随机名称；而明确给出所有名称的 33 个任务则下降 7.3 分，其置信区间包含 0。 有意义的名称和文件续写都不能解释这一下降。 因此，在 TLA + -Bench 的评分方式下，重命名带来的下降同时衡量了评分标准与模型本身，实验 3 检验了这种影响的程度。

paragraphs.en: Qwen. Under the behavior-based grade, training on a task raises the correctness of Qwen by 7.6 points (95% CI 3.8 to 12.0) with the original descriptions and by 4.2 points (95% CI 1.1 to 7.8) with the renamed ones ( Table 2 ; see also Figure T.1 ). The DiD is 3.3 points (95% CI − 0.2 -0.2 to 7.3), and 3.5 points (95% CI 0.4 to 6.9) under the name-based grade on 110 tasks.

paragraphs.en: What Experiment 2 shows. With exposure known, the two parts of a decrease separate. Training leaves a memory of the seen tasks, and renaming removes about half of the likelihood gain in both families, including on keywords and structure that renaming leaves unchanged. On correctness, the DiD interval includes 0 under the behavior-based grade in both families, so the part of a correctness decrease that comes from memory is too small to measure on 90 tasks. Renaming also lowers correctness on tasks a model never saw, by 4.9 points for Qwen, where memory plays no part. A renaming decrease can therefore appear without memorization, and its size depends on the model.
paragraphs.zh: 实验 2 展示了什么。 在曝光已知的情况下，下降的两个部分得以分开。 训练会留下对所见任务的记忆，而重命名会使两个模型家族中的似然增益减少约一半，包括在重命名后保持不变的关键词和结构上也是如此。 在正确率方面，在两个家族中，基于行为的评分下的 DiD 区间都包含 0，因此在 90 个任务上，来自记忆的正确率下降部分太小而无法测量。 重命名还会降低模型从未见过的任务的正确率，Qwen 下降了 4.9 个百分点，而记忆在其中没有起作用。 因此，重命名导致的下降可以在没有记忆化的情况下出现，且其大小取决于模型。

paragraphs.en: Implications for TLA + benchmarks. Experiments 1 and 3 show that a check with the reference configuration file grades both what a specification does and how it names identifiers, and in 78/111 of our tasks the description leaves out a required name. Listing every required name in the task separates the two, but it also tells the model which invariants and properties to write, which removes part of the task. The same check accepts outputs with weaker invariants (Experiment 3), and the SANY exit code overstates parsing (Experiment 1). Of four public TLA + benchmarks, only TLA + -Bench needs a name that the task does not state (see Table Q.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对 TLA+ 基准测试的启示。 实验 1 和实验 3 表明，使用参考配置文件进行的检查既评判规约的功能，也评判其标识符的命名方式，而在我们的 111 个任务中有 78 个的描述遗漏了必需的名称。 在任务中列出所有必需的名称可以区分这两者，但这也会告诉模型该写哪些不变式和属性，从而去除了任务的一部分。 同样的检查会接受具有较弱不变式的输出（实验 3），而 SANY 的退出码会夸大解析结果（实验 1）。 在四个公开的 TLA+ 基准测试中，只有 TLA+-Bench 需要一个任务中未说明的名称（见表 Q.1）。

paragraphs.en: Implications for benchmark builders. From these results, we suggest four practices for TLA + benchmarks, grade by behavior against the reference’s own properties, when grading depends on names, state every required name in the task or report tasks with hidden names separately, count semantic errors as parse failures and re-verify renamed copies with the model checker. The same may hold outside TLA + , because names carry meaning in code as well Le et al. (2025) , and unit tests and proof checkers also look up names that tasks may omit.
paragraphs.zh: 对基准测试构建者的启示。 基于这些结果，我们为 TLA+ 基准测试提出四项实践：依据参考规范自身的属性按行为评分；当评分依赖名称时，在任务中明确列出所有所需名称，或将包含隐藏名称的任务单独报告；将语义错误计为解析失败；并使用模型检测器对重命名副本进行重新验证。 这一点在 TLA+ 之外可能同样成立，因为名称在代码中也承载着含义 Le 等人 (2025)，且单元测试和证明检查器也会查找任务中可能省略的名称。

paragraphs.en: Implications for contamination studies. Experiment 2 shows that, under a grade that ignores names, a decrease after renaming can still come from two sources, memory of the original task and the cost of working with new names, and that known exposure separates them. Memory shows in the models we fine-tuned, since renaming removed about half of the gain from training in how likely the model finds the reference. The cost of new names shows on tasks a model never saw, since memory plays no part there, and under the behavior-based grade it was 4.9 points for Qwen and 1.3 points for Gemma (95% CI − 2.0 -2.0 to 4.9). On a model whose training data is unknown, a single decrease adds these two sources together and cannot separate them. For Opus 4.8 and GPT-5, most of the decrease comes from grading, and the interval of the decrease under the behavior-based grade includes 0 but leaves room for a name cost of several points. Contamination studies could add a model with known exposure and report the decrease separately for seen and unseen items.

sents.en: In the LLMs we fine-tuned, training made the reference specification more likely to the model, and renaming removed about half of that gain.
sents.zh: 在我们微调的大语言模型中，训练使参考规范更贴近模型，而重命名消除了约一半的增益。

sents.en: On tasks a model never saw, renaming lowered correctness by 4.9 points for Qwen and 1.3 points for Gemma.

sents.en: A decrease after renaming therefore mixes memorization with grading by name and with the cost of new names, so it cannot show memorization by itself.

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. The descriptions shape what a model writes, and TLA + -Bench writes them with an LLM. Every comparison in our experiments is paired, because the original and renamed versions of a task share one description and differ only in the renamed identifiers, so the quality of a description affects both conditions equally and does not change the decrease. The renaming rule keeps 91% of the domain words of a description, so the renamed task asks for the same system. The rule also keeps the names of known algorithms such as Paxos, which a model could use to recall a known specification. Tasks with such a name are harder for both frontier models and lose no more correctness under renaming than the other tasks (see Appendix M ), so this risk is small, and a direct test that asks for a specification from the algorithm name alone needs further study. Claude Opus 4.8 proposed the meaningful names and is also tested on them, so these names may suit it. In the exposure experiment, both models of a family share the same 292 training tasks with original names, so even unseen tasks follow naming conventions that the models learned.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 描述决定了模型写出的内容，而 TLA+-Bench 是用大语言模型（LLM）来生成这些描述的。 我们实验中的每一次比较都是配对的，因为任务的原始版本和重命名版本共享同一份描述，仅在重命名的标识符上不同，所以描述质量对两种条件的影响相同，不会改变下降幅度。 重命名规则保留了一份描述中 91% 的领域词汇，因此重命名后的任务要求的仍是同一个系统。 该规则还保留了已知算法的名称（如 Paxos），模型可能会借助这些名称回忆起已知的规约。 带有这类名称的任务对前沿模型来说都更难，并且在重命名后正确率的损失并不比其他任务更多（见附录 M），所以这一风险很小，但仅凭算法名称生成规约的直接测试仍需进一步研究。 Claude Opus 4.8 提出了这些有意义的名称，同时也在这些名称上接受了测试，因此这些名称可能更适合它。 在暴露实验中，同一系列的两个模型共享相同的 292 个使用原始名称的训练任务，因此即使是未见过的任务，也遵循模型已经学到的命名惯例。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. We measure three constructs. Correctness is passing TLC on the finite instance that the configuration bounds, so an output that passes may still be wrong for larger parameters. The behavior-based grade requires as many variables and constants as the reference and searches at most 60 variable mappings, so an output that splits a variable or derives a declared constant fails even when its behaviors match. Its reverse check tests only the output’s safety formula, so it accepts extra fairness conditions. Memorization is the exposure effect of LoRA fine-tuning on each task three times with its test description. Contamination through public files exposes a model to the file alone, and our specification-only arm, which trains this way, stays too low on correctness to show an effect (see Table O.1 ). LoRA updates only small low-rank weights, so it may understate the memory that pretraining leaves. The cost of new names is the decrease on unseen tasks. Random names also lengthen the token sequence, which the truncation analysis controls (see Appendix N ), and CIR keeps the structure of a specification, so a model can still use a recalled structure.
paragraphs.zh: 结构效度。 我们测量三个构念。 正确性是指在配置所限定的有限实例上通过 TLC 验证，因此通过验证的输出在更大的参数下仍可能是错误的。 基于行为的评分要求与参考答案相同数量的变量和常量，并且最多搜索 60 种变量映射，因此即使输出的行为匹配，只要它拆分了某个变量或导出了某个已声明的常量，也会判为失败。 其反向检查只测试输出的安全公式，因此它会接受多余公平性条件。 记忆化是在每个任务上用其测试描述进行三次 LoRA 微调所产生的暴露效应。 通过公开文件造成的污染只是让模型接触到文件本身，而我们仅以这种方式训练的“仅规格”实验组在正确性上始终过低，无法显示出效应（见表 O.1）。 LoRA 只更新少量低秩权重，因此它可能低估预训练留下的记忆。 新名称的代价体现在未见任务上的性能下降。 随机名称还会加长 token 序列，截断分析对此进行了控制（见附录 N），而 CIR 保留了规格的结构，因此模型仍然可以使用回忆起来的结构。

paragraphs.en: Statistical conclusion validity. The main threat is sample size, because public TLA + specifications are few and TLA + -Bench has only 146 model-checked system specifications. The behavior-based grade covers 90 tasks, the group with every required name stated has 33, and the pass rates of the exposure experiment lie between 7% and 23%, so a decrease of a few points falls inside the intervals, and the DiD on correctness includes 0 for both families. The likelihood measure does not depend on correct outputs and shows the exposure effect and its reduction under renaming clearly. We report several comparisons without a correction for multiple tests, and the bootstrap resamples tasks and misses the variation between training runs, since each exposure model is trained once with one split and one seed.

paragraphs.en: TLC checks two kinds of properties, invariants, which must hold in every state the system reaches, and temporal properties, which must hold over whole behaviors. For the clock, an invariant called TypeOK could state that hr is always a number from 1 to 12. A temporal property can be a safety property, such as that a process never leaves a barrier early, or a liveness property, such as that the clock eventually shows 12. A clock that stops ticking may never reach 12, so a liveness property needs a fairness condition in the specification formula, which states that the clock keeps ticking Lamport (2002) .
paragraphs.zh: TLC 检查两类性质：不变量（invariants），必须在系统到达的每个状态中都成立；以及时序性质（temporal properties），必须在完整行为上成立。 对于时钟而言，一个名为 TypeOK 的不变量可以规定 hr 始终是 1 到 12 之间的数字。 时序性质可以是安全性性质，例如某智能体绝不会提前离开屏障；也可以是活性性质，例如时钟最终会显示 12。 停止走动的时钟可能永远到不了 12，因此活性性质需要在规约公式中加入一个公平性条件，该条件规定时钟持续走动 Lamport (2002)。

paragraphs.en: This experiment depends on the behavior-based grade, so we check that it accepts what it should and rejects what it should. We validate it on the 110 tasks that have a configuration. Of these, 8 stay in the test set for name-based grading, since they pass SANY and TLC after renaming and are valid tasks under benchmark practice, and we exclude them from behavior-based grading only. That grade needs TLC results that repeat across runs, which the specifications that use random values do not give, and system behavior to compare, which the test fixtures of the TLA + tools do not describe. This leaves 102 tasks eligible for behavior-based grading. The grader accepts 90/102 references against themselves, and the other 12 use constructs that it does not translate, so the behavior-based grade covers 90/111 tasks (see Table K.1 ). The remaining task has no TLC configuration, so every output for it fails the name-based grade in every condition and does not change any decrease. For positive controls, we grade each reference against itself, a copy of each reference with its operators renamed to random names of the same width, and each renamed reference together with the renamed modules it imports. An operator-renamed copy counts only if it passes SANY and TLC, so operators that the configuration overrides by name or that an INSTANCE substitutes by name keep their names. For negative controls, we mutate each reference. A mutation changes a numeric literal by 1, flips a comparison, replaces a string value in the initial state, or deletes a conjunct of an action, a guard of an action, or a disjunct of the next-state relation. We keep a mutant only if TLC reports a different number of distinct reachable states for it, counted on the data variables for references with control-label variables. Every kept mutant thus behaves differently from its reference, and a correct grader must reject it. This selection makes rejection the easy direction, because TLC already exhibits the difference on the tested instance and the controls include no restructured but behaviorally equivalent specifications beyond renamings, so the false-negative rate on outputs that differ structurally from the reference is known only from the disagreements inspected in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 本实验依赖于基于行为的评分，因此我们检查它是否接受应接受的内容并拒绝应拒绝的内容。 我们在110个具有配置的任务上对其进行验证。 其中，8个任务保留在测试集中用于基于名称的评分，因为它们在重命名后通过SANY和TLC，并且按照基准测试惯例是有效任务；我们仅将它们排除在基于行为的评分之外。 该评分需要跨运行可重复的TLC结果，而使用随机值的规约无法提供这一点；还需要可比较的系统行为，而TLA+工具的测试夹具并未描述这些行为。 这样留下102个任务有资格进行基于行为的评分。 评分器对90/102个参考文档自身予以接受，其余12个使用了它无法翻译的构造，因此基于行为的评分覆盖90/111个任务（见表K.1）。 剩余的任务没有TLC配置，因此它在所有条件下的每个输出都无法通过基于名称的评分，且不会改变任何下降幅度。 对于阳性对照，我们将每个参考文档与其自身评分，与一个将其运算符重命名为相同宽度的随机名称的副本评分，以及与每个重命名后的参考文档连同其导入的重命名模块一起评分。 运算符重命名的副本只有在通过SANY和TLC时才有效，因此配置按名称覆盖的运算符或由INSTANCE按名称替换的运算符保留其原名。 对于阴性对照，我们对每个参考文档进行变异。 变异的方式包括：将一个数字字面量改变1、翻转一个比较、替换初始状态中的字符串值，或删除动作的一个合取项、动作的一个守卫，或后继状态关系的一个析取项。 只有当TLC报告该变异体具有不同数量的不同可达状态时，我们才保留它；对于含控制标签变量的参考文档，该数量是在数据变量上统计的。 因此，每个被保留的变异体的行为都与它的参考文档不同，正确的评分器必须拒绝它。 这种选择使拒绝成为容易的方向，因为TLC已经在被测试的实例上展现出差异，且对照中除了重命名之外不包含结构重组但行为等价的规约，因此在与参考文档结构不同的输出上的假阴性率只能根据第4节中检查的分歧得出。

sents.en: This experiment depends on the behavior-based grade, so we check that it accepts what it should and rejects what it should.
sents.zh: 本实验依赖于基于行为的评分，因此我们检查它是否接受应接受的内容并拒绝应拒绝的内容。

sents.en: We validate it on the 110 tasks that have a configuration.
sents.zh: 我们在110个具有配置的任务上对其进行验证。

sents.en: Of these, 8 stay in the test set for name-based grading, since they pass SANY and TLC after renaming and are valid tasks under benchmark practice, and we exclude them from behavior-based grading only.
sents.zh: 其中，8个任务保留在测试集中用于基于名称的评分，因为它们在重命名后通过SANY和TLC，并且按照基准测试惯例是有效任务；我们仅将它们排除在基于行为的评分之外。

sents.en: That grade needs TLC results that repeat across runs, which the specifications that use random values do not give, and system behavior to compare, which the test fixtures of the TLA + tools do not describe.
sents.zh: 该评分需要跨运行可重复的TLC结果，而使用随机值的规约无法提供这一点；还需要可比较的系统行为，而TLA+工具的测试夹具并未描述这些行为。

sents.en: This leaves 102 tasks eligible for behavior-based grading.
sents.zh: 这样留下102个任务有资格进行基于行为的评分。

sents.en: The grader accepts 90/102 references against themselves, and the other 12 use constructs that it does not translate, so the behavior-based grade covers 90/111 tasks (see Table K.1 ).
sents.zh: 评分器对90/102个参考文档自身予以接受，其余12个使用了它无法翻译的构造，因此基于行为的评分覆盖90/111个任务（见表K.1）。

sents.en: The remaining task has no TLC configuration, so every output for it fails the name-based grade in every condition and does not change any decrease.
sents.zh: 剩余的任务没有TLC配置，因此它在所有条件下的每个输出都无法通过基于名称的评分，且不会改变任何下降幅度。

sents.en: For positive controls, we grade each reference against itself, a copy of each reference with its operators renamed to random names of the same width, and each renamed reference together with the renamed modules it imports.
sents.zh: 对于阳性对照，我们将每个参考文档与其自身评分，与一个将其运算符重命名为相同宽度的随机名称的副本评分，以及与每个重命名后的参考文档连同其导入的重命名模块一起评分。

sents.en: An operator-renamed copy counts only if it passes SANY and TLC, so operators that the configuration overrides by name or that an INSTANCE substitutes by name keep their names.
sents.zh: 运算符重命名的副本只有在通过SANY和TLC时才有效，因此配置按名称覆盖的运算符或由INSTANCE按名称替换的运算符保留其原名。

sents.en: For negative controls, we mutate each reference.
sents.zh: 对于阴性对照，我们对每个参考文档进行变异。

sents.en: A mutation changes a numeric literal by 1, flips a comparison, replaces a string value in the initial state, or deletes a conjunct of an action, a guard of an action, or a disjunct of the next-state relation.
sents.zh: 变异的方式包括：将一个数字字面量改变1、翻转一个比较、替换初始状态中的字符串值，或删除动作的一个合取项、动作的一个守卫，或后继状态关系的一个析取项。

sents.en: We keep a mutant only if TLC reports a different number of distinct reachable states for it, counted on the data variables for references with control-label variables.
sents.zh: 只有当TLC报告该变异体具有不同数量的不同可达状态时，我们才保留它；对于含控制标签变量的参考文档，该数量是在数据变量上统计的。

sents.en: Every kept mutant thus behaves differently from its reference, and a correct grader must reject it.
sents.zh: 因此，每个被保留的变异体的行为都与它的参考文档不同，正确的评分器必须拒绝它。

sents.en: This selection makes rejection the easy direction, because TLC already exhibits the difference on the tested instance and the controls include no restructured but behaviorally equivalent specifications beyond renamings, so the false-negative rate on outputs that differ structurally from the reference is known only from the disagreements inspected in Section 4 .
sents.zh: 这种选择使拒绝成为容易的方向，因为TLC已经在被测试的实例上展现出差异，且对照中除了重命名之外不包含结构重组但行为等价的规约，因此在与参考文档结构不同的输出上的假阴性率只能根据第4节中检查的分歧得出。

Of the 90 operator-renamed copies, 13 have no operator to rename, 3 do not parse and 18 fail TLC, so 56 are valid under that check. All 56 valid operator-renamed copies pass and all 90 renamed references pass together with the renamed modules they import. The grader rejects all 105 kept mutants, which come from the reference specifications of 54 tasks.

paragraphs.en: Setup. For each specification we show the model its first 40% of lines (at least 8 and at most 60), tell it the repository and path the file comes from and ask it to continue the file exactly. The repository and path help a model that saw the file in training recall it Golchin and Surdeanu (2024) . We remove comments and separator lines from the model’s output and from the rest of the real file, and we count the longest stretch of tokens that the two texts share word for word, so a long shared stretch suggests the model has seen the file. We run the same test on the renamed copy, which no model can have seen because it exists only in our study, so its shared stretches show how much matching comes from the common TLA + text alone.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 对于每份规范文件，我们向模型展示其前 40% 的行（至少 8 行，至多 60 行），告知该文件所在的仓库与路径，并要求模型精确续写该文件。 仓库与路径信息有助于在训练中见过该文件的模型将其回忆起来 Golchin and Surdeanu (2024)。 我们从模型输出和真实文件的剩余部分中去除注释和分隔行，并统计两段文本逐词一致的最长连续词元片段，因此较长的共享片段表明模型见过该文件。 我们在重命名的副本上运行同样的测试，由于该副本仅存在于我们的研究中，任何模型都不可能见过它，因此其共享片段显示有多少匹配仅来自共同的 TLA 与文本本身。

paragraphs.en: Findings. Opus 4.8 continues 46/111 specifications with a run of at least 50 tokens identical to the real file, and 25 renamed copies, which exist nowhere online, also produce such a run, since TLA + modules share boilerplate. The 46 tasks whose file has a long run lose 8.7 points of correctness under renaming, and the other 65 lose 11.1 points (permutation p = 0.70 p=0.70 ). The run on the original minus the run on the renamed copy has a Spearman correlation of 0.07 with the decrease (permutation p = 0.48 p=0.48 ), and the 11 tasks above the 95th percentile of runs on renamed copies lose 0.0 points (permutation p = 0.25 p=0.25 ). The continuation test therefore does not predict which tasks lose correctness. GPT-5 continues 11 specifications with a run of at least 50 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果。 Opus 4.8 在 111 个规格中有 46 个续写出至少 50 个 token 与真实文件相同的片段，而 25 个改名的副本（网络上任何地方都不存在）也能产生这样的片段，因为 TLA+ 模块共享样板代码。 在 46 个文件含有长片段的任务中，改名导致正确性下降 8.7 分，另外 65 个任务下降 11.1 分（置换检验 p = 0.70 p=0.70）。 原文件上的片段长度减去改名副本上的片段长度，其与下降幅度的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.07（置换检验 p = 0.48 p=0.48），而在改名副本片段长度处于 95 百分位以上的 11 个任务中，正确性损失为 0.0 分（置换检验 p = 0.25 p=0.25）。 因此，续写测试并不能预测哪些任务会损失正确性。 GPT-5 续写出至少 50 个 token 相同片段的规格有 11 个。

paragraphs.en: Setup. The renamed descriptions keep the names of published algorithms, protocols and classic problems, such as Paxos, the Bakery algorithm, Euclid’s algorithm or the dining philosophers, and a model could use such a name to recall a known specification. We mark the tasks whose renamed description contains a name from a fixed list, which gives 37/111 tasks, and a broader list that adds problem words such as consensus, mutual exclusion and spanning tree gives 48/111. We compare the original correctness and the decrease after renaming between the marked tasks and the others, with a permutation test on the difference between the two mean decreases.
paragraphs.zh: 准备工作。 重命名后的描述保留了已发表算法、协议和经典问题的名称，例如 Paxos、Bakery 算法、欧几里得算法或 Dining Philosophers（哲学家就餐问题），模型可以利用此类名称回想起已知的规范。 我们标记出重命名描述中包含固定列表中名称的任务，共得到 37/111 个任务；使用加入共识、互斥和生成树等问题词汇的更广泛列表则得到 48/111 个任务。 我们比较被标记任务与其他任务在重命名前后的原始正确率和正确率下降幅度，并对两组平均下降幅度之差进行置换检验。

sents.en: Setup.
sents.zh: 准备工作。

sents.en: The renamed descriptions keep the names of published algorithms, protocols and classic problems, such as Paxos, the Bakery algorithm, Euclid’s algorithm or the dining philosophers, and a model could use such a name to recall a known specification.

paragraphs.en: Findings. Tasks with a known name are harder. Under the behavior-based grade, Opus 4.8 is correct on 13.8% of samples for the 32 covered tasks with a known name and on 52.1% for the other 58. The decrease after renaming is 1.2 points (95% CI − 5.6 -5.6 to 7.5) on tasks with a known name and 4.1 points (95% CI − 0.7 -0.7 to 10.0) on the others (permutation p = 0.59 p=0.59 ), and under the name-based grade it is 7.0 and 11.6 points ( p = 0.45 p=0.45 ). The broader list gives p = 0.54 p=0.54 and p = 0.60 p=0.60 , and GPT-5 shows no difference under either grade or list ( p ≥ 0.22 p\geq 0.22 ). A known name thus neither makes a task easier nor protects it from the decrease, so recall through such names does not explain our results. The marked tasks are also the more complex ones, so this comparison cannot rule out a small effect of the names.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果。 名称已知的任务更难。 在基于行为的评分下，Opus 4.8 在 32 个名称已知的覆盖任务上正确率为 13.8%，在其他 58 个任务上正确率为 52.1%。 重命名后，名称已知的任务下降 1.2 分（95% CI −5.6 至 7.5），其他任务下降 4.1 分（95% CI −0.7 至 10.0）（置换检验 p = 0.59）；而在基于名称的评分下，分别下降 7.0 分和 11.6 分（p = 0.45）。 更宽泛的列表给出 p = 0.54 和 p = 0.60，且 GPT-5 在任一评分方式或列表下都没有差异（p ≥ 0.22）。 因此，名称已知既不会使任务变容易，也不能使任务免于下降，所以通过这类名称的记忆并不能解释我们的结果。 被标记的任务也是更复杂的任务，因此这一比较无法排除名称带来的微小影响。

paragraphs.en: Setup. A random name such as Bvwcdylhaazalut splits into many short tokens, so a renamed specification has more tokens, 1,630 on average against 1,457 for the original. The fine-tuned models stop at 1,024 new tokens, so a renamed output is more likely to be cut off and fail, which could lower correctness after renaming without any role for memory. We count the outputs that reach the limit or lack the closing line of a module, and we repeat the analysis on the tasks with no such output in any condition.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 像 Bvwcdylhaazalut 这样的随机名称会被切分成许多短词元，因此重命名后的规格说明包含更多词元，平均为 1,630 个，而原始版本为 1,457 个。 微调后的模型在 1,024 个新词元处停止，因此重命名后的输出更有可能被截断而失败，这可能在重命名后降低正确性，而与记忆无关。 我们统计达到上限或缺少模块结尾行的输出，并在任何条件下都没有此类输出的任务上重复该分析。

paragraphs.en: Findings. Truncated outputs make up 16.9% and 13.5% of the original outputs of the models trained on half A and half B, and 18.7% and 16.9% of the renamed ones. Truncation is slightly more frequent in the renamed condition. On the 43/90 tasks with no truncated output in any condition, the renaming cost on unseen tasks is 9.8 points (95% CI 3.7 to 16.3), so the renaming cost persists on tasks with no truncated outputs. The difference in differences on these tasks is 7.4 points (95% CI 0.0 to 15.3), with an interval that reaches 0. The 43 tasks are not a random sample, because they are the shorter ones, and shorter specifications may be easier to memorize. The difference in differences is positive in every analysis, and its interval excludes 0 only under the name-based grade, so on correctness the evidence that renaming removes the gain from exposure is weak.

paragraphs.en: The two grades disagree in both directions. Of the 450 Opus 4.8 samples per condition, 47 original and 71 renamed samples pass only the behavior-based grade, and 17 and 8 pass only the name-based grade. Behavior-only passes are mostly outputs that miss a hidden name. Reading the specifications behind the name-only passes shows that some describe different behavior. In one task the outputs fix a flag that the reference leaves free in the initial state, and in others an action differs. The name-based grade accepts them because TLC checks the outputs’ own invariants. The other name-only passes come from limits of the behavior-based grade. These outputs encode a value differently, such as TRUE and FALSE for the 0 and 1 of the reference, declare an extra constant or derive one that the reference declares or write the specification formula in a form the grader does not parse. Most GPT-5 name-only passes come from one task with the boolean encoding. If every name-only pass counts as correct, which also credits the outputs with different behavior, the decrease for Opus 4.8 is 5.1 points (95% CI 0.4 to 10.2), half of the 10.4-point decrease under the name-based grade, and for GPT-5 it is 0.4 points (95% CI − 3.1 -3.1 to 4.0).
